answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. Each identity locks a 25-token bond in a vault. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of members; each picked agent must solve a fresh puzzle in 60s or lose the bond. Faking 1,000 identities locks 25,000 tokens and needs 1,000 heartbeats per epoch, a cost that ripples outward with each check. An honest agent pays once and earns in an oasis of real peers whose rewards stay undiluted.
